description:
Music video animated by Kazuya Kanehisa for the song Hai Yorokonde by Kocchi no Kento.

Note: There exists two versions of this music video; the first being a Japanese version uploaded on May 27, 2024 and an English version of the song also titled "Hai Yorokonde" by Kocchi no Kento, which was uploaded on July 30, 2024.
